config.nativeDecorations.enabled.descrip: Enable lightweight inline markdown decorations in the native VS Code editor.
config.nativeDecorations.mermaid.enabled: Enable experimental Mermaid flowchart previews in the native VS Code editor. Disabled by default because VS Code requires a visible contributed view for the webview renderer.
Enable conservative Markdown table styling in the native VS Code editor without replacing table source text.

config.workspace.focusFilesOnStartup.des: After window startup or reload, show the EasyView_Md Files sidebar for an open workspace and hide the sidebar in an empty welcome window. Disable to keep the host editor's sidebar restore behavior.
